verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog documents enforced access control when tables are queried, plus table creation with privilege grants, so table-level role-based control is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents column-level permissions, row filters, or dynamic masking policies, and a community comparison describes Databricks security as table-level only. missing for 10: column-level access control, row-level filtering, masking policies, evidence of multi-team isolation on one warehouse, independent hands-on corroboration.
